conf.comment: ServiceNow transaction log (syslog_transaction) via System Export Sets JSON file. Direct route. recommendations.direct.cribl calls for the same URL normalization/drop rules as the guarded path; percent-decoding and the static-asset/polling-URL drop rule are NOT implemented here because no concrete pattern or allow-list is given anywhere in the work order (see README gap). sys_id dedup across overlapping exports not implemented in-pipeline (see README gap).

functions.description: Cribl File Source reads the exported JSON array; extract fields from _raw

split url into path/query (url.domain is not set - the instance hostname is not present in the row and is not guessed, see README gap), convert response_time ms to event.duration ns, cast output_length to a number, map transaction origin and session id to custom fields, set _time, tag event.dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
